entity.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)

lineage.description: IOM DTM teams conducted repeated site assessments at IDP camps in Haiti following the 2010 and 2021 earthquakes, documenting displaced populations and household counts at camp level using standardized DTM methodology. Data were compiled across 32 assessment rounds spanning both earthquake events and aggregated into this multi-round dataset.

sources.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)
sources.description: IOM DTM conducts standardized site-level assessments of internally displaced populations following displacement-triggering events. This dataset aggregates camp-level counts of IDPs and households across multiple assessment rounds.
